body:
- Use new Cython-specific GraalPy APIs that I added to make the array module work
- Add a few remaning changes that avoid direct struct access to objects that are handles in GraalPy
- Remove many passing tests from the graalpy bug list
- Test spearately 25.0 (LTS, 3.12) and 25.3 (3.13)

CC @timfel

comment_data.body:
Is there a reason to test this version and not `25.2`? (which looks like it's also Python 3.12).

(I'm happy to believe that there is a reason - you know better than me what you're trying to do longer-term support for - but thought it was worth checking).
25.0 is a LTS release, it's still supported and we're still somewhat able to fix major bugs. 25.2 was one of the monthly feature releases, it's already superseded by 25.3.
